text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm in the mood for a good flick on one of
my days off. Little do I
expect to see
Mejiro Dober in the lobby.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Eh? You've got the wrong person!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's just you.
Don't just shout out from
behind someone! Of course
I was surprised!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer... You really surprised me,
calling out suddenly from
behind me like
that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well, that's...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well, that's...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I suppose I can tell you since you went
ahead and looked that one
time...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I suppose you already know after
seeing my illustrations.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I was thinking of seeing this today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I was thinking of seeing this today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober reaches for her smartphone
and pulls up a ticket she
had reserved
online.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a ticket for the film "Veggie
Caroline: Veggin' Out on Summer
Vacation!" It's the
latest entry in the kids' anime series she
was drawing characters of.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I was actually supposed to watch it with
Ryan, but something came up
with her, so
now I'm here alone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And there are a lot more children here
than I imagined... I'll probably
stand out
quite a lot.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami was telling me that the new
"Pretty Fighters" movie was
about half
adults and half kids, so I thought this
might be similar...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I don't see any other academy students
either, so I feel like I'll
definitely be
standing out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should just wait until Ryan is
free
again...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hm, but the limited-edition entry bonuses
are sure to run out before
then. I probably
can't afford to wait.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You had to have come here because
there's something you
wanted to see. I'm
positively sure that it wasn't Veggie
Caroline.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You had to have come here because
there's something you
wanted to see.
Don't feel like you need to force yourself
for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Really now... Well, don't blame me if
you're bored to death or
something. Have
it your way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Is that right? Well,
if you're okay with it,
then by all means, I'd like to
have you see
it with me.

text_block_list.name: Theater Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Seating has begun at screen 2 for "Veggie
Caroline: Veggin' Out on
Summer
Vacation!"

text_block_list.name: Theater Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Seating has begun at screen 2 for "Veggie
Caroline: Veggin' Out on
Summer
Vacation!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well, that's us... Let's go, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well, that's us... Let's go, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone receives a special sticker sheet
as they enter the theater. My white sheet
is lined with various holographic stickers
featuring
movie characters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone receives a special sticker sheet
as they enter the theater. My white sheet
is lined with various holographic stickers
featuring
movie characters.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Is that okay? Th-thanks. I was actually
thinking that I might have to
see the movie
again to get another sheet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Is that okay? To be honest, I was wanting
to get two sheets, and I
would have had to
see the movie again. This really helps.
Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Your stickers are white.
Too bad it's still
not my preferred color.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Your stickers are white.
Too bad it's still
not my preferred color.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The stickers are not arranged randomly on
the sheets. The only
difference is the
background color.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That may be so,
but it's exactly because of
that it would be nice to
get your favorite
color.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I bet that little kids can get really
upset
about it. In fact, I heard some
parents
talking about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I didn't... really do that.
Ryan was always
there to smooth things over
or get me the
color I wanted.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I didn't really, no. Ryan would always
arrange to get us younger kids
the colors
we wanted.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Wait,
this conversation is kind of silly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Wait,
this conversation is kind of silly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I can ask the staff if I can
exchange
them for some green ones.

text_block_list.name: Theater Staff
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, but we're unable to allow color
choice or exchange of the
stickers. We ask
for your understanding.

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
The nice lady says we can't change them.
Let's go with this color,
okay? Look, it
even has Caroline!

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: Nooo! I don't want green!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like this little girl's stickers
are green. I can't help but notice
that the red
outfit she is wearing is rather close to
Caroline's in the movie.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? They're red.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hm, hers are green all right. But how can
you be so sure that she'd
want red?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A skeptical Mejiro Dober and I approach
the parent and child.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A skeptical Mejiro Dober and I approach
the parent and child.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That worked out well... How on earth did
you know that she wanted
red?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That worked out well... Trainer, how did
you know that she wanted
red stickers?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that since Caroline also wears
red
overalls, she may have
been trying to
imitate her favorite character.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that since Caroline also wears
red
overalls, she may have
been trying to
imitate her favorite character.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I see... Well I guess that should be
expected of a trainer. It's kind of
your job
to be observant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Observation skills to be expected of a pro
trainer I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That kid probably thinks you're a big fan
of Veggie Caroline now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That kid probably thinks you're a big fan
of Veggie Caroline now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I think you managed to stand out even
more than me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I think you managed to stand out even
more than me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The movie turned out to be much more
interesting than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I was pretty surprised to see them give so
much screen time to some of the more
obscure characters.
The little ones at home must have
been talking about them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You know... I have a much younger sister
and brother.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
They both seem to really love Veggie
Caroline. I wanted to know more about
what they were talking about, so that's
why I wanted to
come see it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm glad I was able to get their
favorite colors. If it were just me, there
would have been no way I could approach
anyone else to
exchange them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So thanks... for watching the movie with
me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Watching the movie with me was a big
help, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I was able to relax and not worry about
any eyes that would be on
me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I was able to relax and not worry about
any eyes that would be on
me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It was kind of reassuring...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Having you there next to me was rather
reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: So that's the long and short of it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, Mejiro Dober picks up her
pace and walks out ahead of
me, her hair
glistening and swaying in the twilight
glow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, Mejiro Dober turns her eyes
shyly away from mine. Her
profile glows a
faint crimson in the twilight gleam.
